run_lvis_cat_info: run the script to extract LVIS category information from an annotation JSON file
run_lvis_cat_info_with_freq: run the script with --add_freq to classify categories as rare, common, or frequent
run_lvis_cat_info_custom_thresholds: run the script with custom --r_thresh and --c_thresh values for frequency classification
run_lvis_cat_info_custom_ann: run the script with a custom --ann path to process a different LVIS annotation file
run_lvis_cat_info_output: run the script to generate a _cat_info.json file with image and instance counts per category
